create_tree_dataclass: create a Tree dataclass instance to hold and inspect MCTS search data for a batch of inputs
build_search_summary: build a SearchSummary dataclass containing visit counts, visit probabilities, values, and qvalues from a Tree
test_tree_qvalues: test the Tree.qvalues method to compute q-values for any node indices in the search tree
summarize_tree_root: summarize the Tree.summary method to extract aggregate statistics and induced probabilities for the root node
run_infer_batch_size: run the infer_batch_size function to recover the batch dimension from a Tree data structure
